notes.title: The Extra Boss and Ending
notes.content:
This is the 1.3 update to Keep of the Witch. It adds the Extra Boss fight and the two Extra Endings. This update is for the anniversary of the game's release on the 21/22 of November. The reason I'm releasing it now is because the development is already done and I might forget to release it then. Rather be early than late. Anyways, let me explain about the contents of the update.

With the ring of souls in hand, things happen and the Entity of Souls is spawned. You must defeat it and see through the end of the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43042121/61ce95cd51ec6faa2914d91f32f480a77a61ceeb.jpg


added Boss: Entity of Souls
added Entity Stage 1 Level
added Entity Stage 2 Level
added Two Extra Story Endings
added Gallery Extra Portrait
added continue Character Portrait (Defaulting with the 1st Princess)


fixed ring of souls Dialogue icon from feather to ring
fixed some audio issues 



Now to explaining on how to unlock the Extra Boss Fight. In order to access the fight, you have to have completed a character run once, any of the characters. Once you do, complete a run whilst obtaining the ring of souls from the Cellar. When you save the 2nd Princess, the cutscene should be different. That's when you know you'll be sent to the extra boss fight. The Boss has 4 Phases and when you die, you know what happens. There should be NO fail condition once you reach the extra boss so there's that. That should be all about the boss fight, the update, and everything else. I hope you enjoy it.

Finally, for what's next. I'm not planning any more big updates for Keep of the Witch for a while. Maybe some random day next year I'll add the achievements. Also, the model for the 2nd Princess doesn't exist in game yet, [strike]or does she?[/strike] When I'm feeling really bored, I might make her playable with an alternate story. Anyways, time to fully work on the RPG game I'm working on. It has no relation to KotW's story or characters. But will there be a sequel to KotW? well.....

-regalfang

notes.title: The Maid
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43042121/2aadb56d8ce70785919dcb7e290db1a4ced34bb3.jpg

In this update; version 1.2, the major addition to this game is the character, the maid. They are now an unlockable character that you can play as, and. That's pretty much it, other than some other stuff, that's what I've added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43042121/85c0b757fdb00e7e7e7d20dded05b6e4f3ccf466.jpg


added the Maid Character
added the Maid Ending
added the Knight as supporting cast
did not add the Knight dialogue 
added controller rumble when player gets damaged ;)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43042121/75eab0e29cc87fa2be2107edf195a62acfc91b72.jpg

so about the maid being unlockable, in order to unlock them you have two methods; the easy way and the hard way. I will fully explain them here. The hard way is by completing the bonus mode. In order to increase the odds of doing that, you have to ether obtain the vampiric skill or the executioner skill. It makes it easier to defeat the final boss. The easy way is pretty archaic. You have to play as the knight, then sit down next to the maid, talk to them, then say yes when the prompt comes. Not so hard.

Finally, stuff to come. For Keep of the Witch, I plan on adding the extra boss around the time of the anniversary of the game, so within this year. For other games, I'm currently working on a turn based RPG. It's kind a hard, to make not play, but I'm progressing through. Lastly, um hope you enjoy the update.
-regalfang

notes.title: keep of the witch Update?
notes.content:
well... This is the version 1.1 update of Keep of the Witch. I fixed a decent amount of stuff pertaining to collisions, so the game should run the same unless you have been encountering specific collision related bugs. Aside from that, I've added the Cellar Level, an optional part of the castle that holds an item which will make the final boss more easier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43042121/596bf2473e1cc59cfda94cdbfa5540c396e4075e.png


added the Cellar Level
added Boss: the Elemental
added Item: Ring of Souls
added maid cellar dialog
added the Castle floor Teleport System

fixed a statistic on the character: 1st Princess
fixed some of the collision overlaps
fixed world save issues where upon level reset via death may also reset Bosses and their Doors


Because I had to edit most of the assets, it has to redownload most of the game. Sorry about that, unless your new here then good for you. 

If you're interested in what's next, well here it is. I'm currently working on another game; different game, different genre, but that doesn't mean Keep of the Witch is done with updates. When I feel like adding something, I'll drop whatever I'm doing and add it within a reasonable time. Keep of the Witch will not have any DLC, everything I add here will be part of the main game's update. What could I add next? maybe the achievement system and or an extra end boss. No promises though. 
-regalfang
